Frequently Asked Questions

How much does it cost to hire an Angular developer with Mobilunity?

The cost will depend on the location and seniority of your coders, regional market demand, and our cooperation plan. Schedule a free consultation so we can estimate the cost of your solution.

Is building a web app in AngularJS a secure choice?

Since the support of AngularJS ended in 2021, we recommend using the latest Angular framework for software development. Consider hiring dedicated AngularJS developers to rapidly migrate legacy apps to ensure their security, performance, and maintainability. Otherwise, implement strict security measures like APIs and dependencies and prioritize upgrading soon.

Do you offer help with technical interviews?

Sure, technical interviewing is one of the services we offer, as we have tech specialists available on board. You save time and resources while we cover end-to-end assessment of your candidates’ hard skills. 

Are Mobilunity’s developers proficient in all Angular versions?

Our engineers are well-versed in Angular 16, the latest stable version, and have experience in migration from its older versions and AngularJS. They understand modular architecture for reactive programming, server-side rendering (SSD) with Angular Universal, and testing frameworks like Jasmine, Cypress, or Karma.

Can I hire a web app developer for hourly or project-based tasks?

Either option is possible, from hourly time and material basis to fixed monthly prices for long-term projects. We also offer the EDR (Effective Daily Rate) approach that excludes holidays and vacations, making our cooperation different from typical employment.

Can your web developers help me complete my pending app development project?

Absolutely. You can contract expert AngularJS developers and Angular 2 specialists with your industry experience to catch up on your app development from any stage.

Do you provide support and maintenance services after deployment?

Of course, Mobilunity’s developers ensure bug fixes, feature updates, and security enhancements of your web applications. They’ll keep your solution scalable, up-and-going, and aligned with tech advancements.

What is the cost of hiring web development specialists on an hourly basis?

Your project specifics and developers’ experience and location will impact the hourly rate, so book a free call to estimate the cost.

How much do your Angular development services cost?

Mobilunity isn’t an outsourcing Angular development company delivering turnkey solutions. Instead, we help you contract Angular adepts and top AngularJS developers to build projects that fit your business needs and priorities. So, you cover the cost of hiring a dedicated development team to provide the services you need.

Which industries can benefit from Angular solutions?

You can contract Angular developers to create apps for SaaS providers, e-commerce companies, digital agencies, startups and scale-ups, financial and healthcare institutions, and enterprises with complex web applications. This technology is also ideal for travel, logistics, real estate, and educational organizations.
